authority.prior_result_role: Consumed G05 citation regression only; not new evidence, reusable grant or I02 completion.

budget.admission: Every exact request must be hashed, journaled and reserved before SDK invocation; one shared aggregate ledger enforces both 12 calls and the new hard cap. Per-stage caps and this full schedule bound also apply. No release/reuse of failed or unused allowance for other requests. Stop on unknown usage/cost/transport status; invoice stays null until externally verified.
budget.cost_basis: Conservative frozen-code usage-rated peak reservation; not actual invoice cost or a vendor guarantee of pricing.
budget.unknown_hcl_answer_request_bytes: Dynamic; cannot be known before planning/native execution. Reserve 36000 bytes for each of four possible HCL answers.

execution.after_outputs: Lock unchanged raw final fields and scores; report results including missing treatment, failures, losses and ties. Future repairs are a new separately reviewed task, never edits to this frozen batch.
execution.arm_isolation: New isolated session for each HCL case; same complete frozen source/question for both arms; neither arm sees the other output. Rubric/domain labels do not enter prompts. HCL uses unchanged normal planner inventory and runtime. No external retrieval or provider subcalls.
execution.hcl_answer_gate: Exactly one planning attempt. At most one answer attempt, only if unchanged UniversalHCL obtains an actual native result. An honest insufficient-evidence native result may proceed. Empty plans/all unavailable adapters have no Base fallback. Record absence/irrelevance of checked treatment, not a reason to replace the item.
execution.local_failures: Preserve and continue the predeclared remaining arms/items after known bounded content/schema/selection/adaptation failures when reservation, usage and transport status are known. Do not rerun or repair. Unknown send/deadline/usage/cost, model drift, source/runtime/hash drift or aggregate admission failure stops the batch; remaining arms are NOT_ATTEMPTED.
execution.no_truncation: An HCL answer request above 36000 bytes is an honest no-answer overflow. Never shorten source, policy, translations or operations to fit after observing results.
execution.terminal: After one ordered pass, any global stop, expiry or cancellation, close grant with remaining authorized calls/USD zero. No trigger rearming and no transfer to a follow-on batch.

freeze.base_system_policy_append: The answer field must contain a nonblank answer; state an evidence limitation explicitly rather than leaving it empty.
freeze.planning_payload: question + exact frozen source rows + [asdict(c) for c in CATALOG.values()] in unchanged catalog order
freeze.scope_of_freeze: Sources/questions/rubric, runtime, common contract, model settings, request identities and rate envelope frozen now. No runner/trigger/grant is implemented by this proposal; a future bounded execution package still requires review before one launch.
freeze.serializer: User message content: json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True), default separators. Exact metered request: ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon), UTF-8. Requests are canonical metering representations, not a claim of byte-identical SDK HTTP framing.

latency.exclusions: Exclude checkout/install/CI queue, credential presence checks, common file loading, score review, artifact encryption/publication and unrelated idle time equally for both arms.
latency.failure_handling: Give status and elapsed/censored-to-timeout duration for failed arms; never call a short failure a speed gain. At most four pairs, serial alternating order, no general latency or causal claim.
latency.primary: Arm wall time in monotonic seconds: start when the common frozen source/question is passed to a ready arm with client already initialized, before arm-specific source setup/serialization/reservation; stop after final schema/citation validation or terminal failure. HCL includes source setup, planner, local native work and answer. Base includes its corresponding source/prompt preparation and one answer.
latency.secondary: Record monotonic SDK-invocation-to-return/failure for each provider call, phase durations, and local HCL work; report sum and total wall time. Compare end-to-end arm wall times, not HCL final-call latency alone.

public_output_approval_request.destination: Public evidence artifact and summary in the same GitHub repository haohongfei2001-png/human-cognition-layer, for this exact four-case batch only.
exclude: Provider reasoning_content, raw provider envelopes, raw planning output, complete private receipts, secrets or authentication data.
Protected/confirmation/gold/sealed material, unrelated historical artifacts or other projects, or any output outside the exact four-case scope.
include: These four original synthetic source texts/questions, version/text/request/rubric/package hashes and the frozen scoring criteria.
Unchanged canonical final answer/source_citations/uncertainty/assumptions for at most four Base and four HCL outputs; unavailable placeholders and fixed safe failure codes.
Model/runtime/run/commit identity; per-call usage, frozen-rate estimates/reservations, bounded timestamps/durations, call totals and closed-budget status.
Selected/executed/checked-treatment capability IDs and counts plus bounded source-first factual-review scores/reasons; no efficacy or I02 certification.
public_output_approval_request.safety: An explicit new limited public-output exception is required alongside the separate spending approval. No such approval is represented by this proposal.

settings.model_temperature: Unset in existing metered request for every call
settings.provider: Existing DeepSeek account and https://api.deepseek.com destination only
